title: Affine open sections continuity for canonical transformation
statement: Under the hypotheses of new-local-stalk-sections-canonical-colimit, any natural transformation satisfying the displayed component formula has a colimiting cocone.

proof.text: Use affine-open-sections-descent for surjectivity of the underlying type cocone.

If two sections a,b at one stage have equal images, the group homomorphism nu sends a-b to zero. Apply affine-open-sections-zero-detection to a-b. The restriction homomorphism sends a-b to zero exactly when the restrictions of a and b are equal.

Apply Mathlib CategoryTheory.Limits.Types.FilteredColimit.isColimitOf' to the underlying cocone with these two properties. The forgetful functor from AddCommGrpCat preserves filtered colimits and reflects isomorphisms; reflectsColimit_of_reflectsIsomorphisms and isColimitOfReflects lift the result to additive groups.

proof_origin.place: Degree-zero continuity reduced to representative descent and eventual zero, combined with Mathlib filtered-colimit recognition

mathlib_searches.results: No exact theorem for supplied adjunction and etale sites.
